summary: SK hynix filed a Form 6-K disclosing a board-approved capital expenditure for new semiconductor fabrication facilities at the Yongin Semiconductor Cluster (Y2), Korea. The investment amounts to KRW 35,224.6 billion (29.19% of total equity as of Dec 31, 2025) for phases 1-6 of Fab 2, with a projected period from August 7, 2026 to October 31, 2031. The board resolution was unanimous among six independent directors. This is an ordinary capital expenditure, not a special-situation transaction. There are no deal terms, pricing, or risk-arbitrage angles; the filing is routine operational disclosure.
